name: Viking 1 lander
story: The first American lander to operate successfully on Mars. It photographed the surface and performed experiments on Martian soil.

name: Pathfinder and Sojourner
story: A lander and the first wheeled rover to operate on Mars.

name: Spirit
story: A Mars rover that explored the surface and found evidence of past water.

name: Opportunity
story: A rover that operated for about 14 years and discovered evidence of ancient water.

name: Phoenix
story: A stationary lander that confirmed the presence of water ice beneath the Martian surface.

name: InSight
story: A lander that studied the interior of Mars and recorded marsquakes.
